The '''Contraband Resale Corporation''' was a premier supplier of weapons, transportation, armor, and equipment during the time of the [[Old Republic era|Old Republic]]. During the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] following its [[Conquest of Makeb|seizure]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] found itself with innumerable amounts of embargoed goods. The corporation was formed to catalog and sell these surplus items to the galactic community.
